subject: chemistry
stem: A crystal of purple potassium manganate(VII) was added to hot water and to cold water. Which row is correct?

options.A: colour spreads faster in cold water; particles move faster at a higher temperature
options.B: colour spreads faster in cold water; particles move slower at a higher temperature
options.C: colour spreads faster in hot water; particles move faster at a higher temperature
options.D: colour spreads faster in hot water; particles move slower at a higher temperature
